verdicts.reason: A: the headline and date read well on one line, but the RSVP CTA is buried as a tiny button at the bottom centre. The subtitle and details are crushed into microscopic body text at the top right, and the badge pills are sliced into a cramped strip above it. B: the CTA is clearly visible on the right, but the layout is badly overstuffed. The headline breaks onto two lines, and the italic subtitle is squeezed into a narrow 5-line column with awful wrapping. The three badge pills are stacked vertically and compete with the CTA, and the URL is illegible.
